shortBio.en: Soundgarden guitarist; drop tunings, odd meters, Sabbath-weight riffs inside grunge.
shortBio.zh: Soundgarden 吉他手；降调、奇数拍、grunge 里的 Sabbath 重量 riff。

body.en:
Born 1960. Co-founder. Badmotorfinger / Superunknown riffs: dissonant intervals, alternate tunings.

Cornell’s range sits on Thayil’s forms.
body.zh:
1960 年生。联合创始人。Badmotorfinger / Superunknown riff：不协和音程、另类调弦。

Cornell 音域坐在 Thayil 曲式上。
